predictions: core_v6 preds, block CV out-of-fold, year_obs, F8TS; R1 catboost lam 0.5 (3 seeds averaged), P1 recalibrated Stefan
products: products_cell_year_v5.csv via polar.testbed_v5.load_v5: value of the observation year (prod_wei, prod_liu)
cell_years: per year: labelled cell-years where R1, P1 and Wei 2026 all have values; Liu 2024 (to 2020) is included when it leaves >= 30 cell-years, otherwise the year is shown without Liu; years with < 30 cell-years are not shown
mask_km: 0 = all cell-years; 25 = cells more than 25 km from Wei 2026 training sites (xg_leak_cells_v1.csv, as v5_common_cells.py)
